name: DCW Ltd
title: DCW Ltd - 500117 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: C-PVC capacity doubled to 50kt and sold out, but realisations fell over 20% and PVC-C-PVC spread compressed, so FY26 EBITDA rose only 11% to Rs240cr and FY27 Rs400cr target was effectively abandoned.

utilisation.quote: we are more or less at capacity for the SIOP

capex.peers_comment: Epigral, Lubrizol, Reliance, Grasim adding C-PVC capacity
capex.quote: we are just waiting out for these couple of months for the geopolitics to play out to its fullest

triggers.label: C-PVC realisations down 22%
triggers.quote: the significant reduction in NR by 22% in C-PVC with no consumerate reduction in PVC input prices
triggers.highlight: reduction in NR by 22% in C-PVC

triggers.label: Rs400cr EBITDA target not reachable
triggers.quote: the Rs.400 crores number which we had communicated as a part of a couple of years plan, that actually gets bit derailed

triggers.label: New C-PVC capacity coming (Epigral, Lubrizol)
triggers.quote: Epigral has come in , Epigral and our volumes put together still leaves a lot of headroom for import
triggers.highlight: Epigral and our volumes put together

triggers.label: Caustic realisation ~$400 in Q1
triggers.quote: as we talk in Q1 the realization is in the north of $400

triggers.label: Europe PVC capacity closures (~2 lakh t)
triggers.quote: I think Vinova is one capacity, I think that is some 2 lakh tons which got closed
triggers.highlight: some 2 lakh tons which got closed

guidance.value: Net cash positive after scheduled repayment of Rs130cr in FY27
guidance.quote: we will be net cash positive company
roughly it should go down to Rs.50 crores

guidance.value: not guided; Rs300cr question not answered
guidance.quote: We would not be able to give you a guidance on that

prior_guidance_check.quote: the Rs.400 crores number which we had communicated as a part of a couple of years plan, that actually gets bit derailed
we will be debt-free, because we have Rs. 71 crores of net debt

red_flags.label: Dumping duties found positive but never implemented
red_flags.quote: despite there was a positive finding, those duties never got implemented

red_flags.label: Promoter/Times Group cap table relationship deflected
red_flags.quote: I think all these things better you write to our company secretary

red_flags.label: EBITDA target dropped; capex on hold
red_flags.quote: we are just holding back because we just want to see the geopolitics how it shapes up

evasions.quote: I mean that breakup we generally do not give , but we will take your question and come back if required
I think all these things better you write to our company secretary
